measurement: ASCII bytes of the complete encoded absolute /auth/login URL, including origin, return_to and screen/prompt parameters
rationale: Half the smallest configured hop budget (nginx 8192-byte request line), leaving room for method/protocol and canonical-host redirects. Cloudflare URI limit is 32768 bytes; GCLB URL plus headers limit is at least 61440 bytes. Independent SDK constants must match this contract; the web imports the TypeScript SDK constant.
